title: Intelligent Light Mode Update
headline: Light Mode now scales back every background process across the app — not just the dashboard graphs — for a noticeably lighter footprint on lower-end machines.
changes: Improved: Light Mode now slows down live telemetry, network diagnostics, and background refresh timers everywhere in the app, not just the main dashboard.
Improved: Live performance graphs release more memory while in Light Mode instead of holding a full history buffer in the background.
Improved: Cached data is now cleared more aggressively in Light Mode to free up memory sooner.
Improved: Glow effects, blur, and shadow visuals are further reduced in Light Mode for smoother performance on lower-end hardware.
Fixed: A few background timers (network monitor, trial countdown) were previously unaffected by Light Mode — they now scale down correctly.
